dedupe_keys.name: pig population data complementing the annual report on the epidemiological analyses of african swine fever asf in the european union latvia

description: Latvia’s Agricultural Data Centre publishes pig-population data supporting EFSA’s annual African swine fever analysis. The April 2026 Zenodo version provides an XLSX extraction labelled ASF2025, free under CC BY 4.0. The landing page records earlier 2022–2024 submissions and links the corresponding reporting guidance and 2026 analysis report. These observations can supply livestock-population baselines for agricultural disruption and food-supply resilience simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Latvian extraction. The current file must not be treated as a single workbook containing all previous annual submissions. A note about an earlier 2022 republication says establishment and subunit identifiers were removed for data protection; its applicability to the current workbook was not established. Spatial detail, reference-date definition, included animal categories and missing-value treatment remain unknown from the metadata. The workbook was not downloaded, and animal counts or reporting completeness were not independently checked.
